basic_details.short_information: One post of Rajbhasha-Hindi Translator Grade III (राजभाषा-हिन्दी अनुवादक ग्रेड III) is vacant at Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (भारत हेवी इलेक्ट्रिकल्स लिमिटेड), Component Fabrication Plant (CFP), Rudrapur, Udham Singh Nagar, Uttarakhand. The post is unreserved (UR) and is a fixed tenure appointment (FTA). Candidates send the filled application form and scanned self-attested copies of their certificates by email to [email protected] by 20 November 2026.

selection_process: Selection is through an interview of eligible candidates.

applications will be screened on the merit of total marks obtained in graduation
and at most 10 candidates will be shortlisted for the interview. If two candidates have equal marks at graduation level
the candidate with higher marks in the Hindi subject will be given preference. Applicants who meet the prescribed criteria will be called to BHEL Rudrapur
and the information will be sent separately by email. Original documents must be produced at the time of the interview. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates attending the interview.
important_instructions: A self-declaration on character and background is required at the time of joining. No relaxation will be given in health standards under the clinical/medical joining norms. The selected candidate must show a medical fitness certificate from an authorised medical officer in the prescribed format. This appointment will not give any right to regular employment in BHEL. BHEL has the full right to reschedule, cancel, suspend or end this process, and to change the rules, without giving any reason. The management's decision will be final. Corrigendum, extension of the deadline and any other information will be published only on the website careers.bhel.in.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The BHEL Rudrapur Hindi Translator application goes by email only. The notice gives these steps: The notice does not prescribe a subject line for the email. For any clarification, candidates may call 05944257-269/265/207. The bio data form asks for the post applied for, name in capital letters as per the High School certificate, father's name, date of birth, age in years and months as on 30.10.2026, category (GEN/SC/ST/OBC/EWS), nationality, whether physically challenged (VH/OH/HH) with percentage, address for correspondence, educational qualifications (graduation, post graduation, PG diploma and others, with marks and percentage), experience details, whether the candidate has applied for other vacancies elsewhere, whether a parent or spouse has been in BHEL service (with staff number and unit), phone number and email ID. It ends with a signed declaration that the information is true, and that the engagement is liable to be terminated summarily without notice or compensation if any information is found incorrect or concealed.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post, Rajbhasha-Hindi Translator Grade III, with the specialisation Hindi–English translation and vice versa. The post is unreserved (UR). Master's degree in Hindi with English as a subject at graduation level; OR Master's degree in English with Hindi as a subject at graduation level; OR Master's degree in both Hindi and English; OR Bachelor's degree with English and Hindi as main subjects. At least 02 years of English-Hindi and Hindi-English translation experience is essential. The maximum age limit is 35 years as on 30/10/2026, as per the rules of the BHEL Fixed Tenure Appointment (FTA) policy. Relaxation in the maximum age limit is as per the existing rules of the Government of India and BHEL: Tenure: appointment for 2 years or till completion of the work, whichever is earlier. The appointment is purely on a temporary basis for the initial two years or till completion of the work (whichever is earlier). Either side must give one month's notice to end the appointment. Working hours: at most eight (8) hours a day and six (6) days a week, as per the unit's fixed working days. Leave: one day of leave for every 20 days of work. Medical benefit, accident insurance and accommodation: payable as per the applicable BHEL FTA policy/guidelines and Corporate Office directions. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested scanned photocopies of these documents go with the emailed form; the originals must be shown at the interview: Proof of date of birth – SSC / Intermediate certificate Graduation certificate with marks list Post-graduation certificate with marks list Experience certificate of at least 02 years on the letterhead of the competent authority (with clear details of work period and area of work) Category certificate (PwD), if applicable Copy of Aadhaar card

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through an interview of eligible candidates. The interview will be held at BHEL CFP Rudrapur in the first week of December 2026. If more than 10 applications are received, applications will be screened on the merit of total marks obtained in graduation, and at most 10 candidates will be shortlisted for the interview. If two candidates have equal marks at graduation level, the candidate with higher marks in the Hindi subject will be given preference. Applicants who meet the prescribed criteria will be called to BHEL Rudrapur, and the information will be sent separately by email. Original documents must be produced at the time of the interview. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BHEL Rudrapur Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Rajbhasha-Hindi Translator Grade III, and it is unreserved (UR).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the BHEL Hindi Translator Grade III post?
faq.answer: The filled form and scanned documents must be emailed to [email protected] by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for BHEL Hindi Translator Grade III?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Hindi with English at graduation level, or in English with Hindi at graduation level, or in both Hindi and English, or a Bachelor's degree with English and Hindi as main subjects, plus at least 02 years of English-Hindi and Hindi-English translation experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the BHEL Hindi Translator post?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years as on 30/10/2026, with 10 years' relaxation for PwD candidates having at least 40% disability.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of BHEL Rajbhasha-Hindi Translator Grade III?
faq.answer: The pay is ₹45,000/- per month in the first year and ₹48,000/- per month in the second year.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the BHEL Rudrapur Hindi Translator post?
faq.answer: Fill the bio data form printed below the advertisement, scan it with self-attested photocopies of the listed certificates, and email them to [email protected] by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How will BHEL select the Hindi Translator?
faq.answer: Through an interview at BHEL CFP Rudrapur in the first week of December 2026; if more than 10 applications come in, at most 10 candidates are shortlisted on the merit of total graduation marks, with higher Hindi marks breaking a tie.

faq.question: Q8. Is the BHEL Hindi Translator Grade III job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary fixed tenure appointment for 2 years or till completion of the work, whichever is earlier, and it gives no right to regular employment in BHEL.

faq.question: Q9. Will BHEL pay TA/DA for the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the working hours and leave for this post?
faq.answer: Work is at most 8 hours a day and 6 days a week, with one day of leave for every 20 days of work.
